sources.title: harshbhalodia/loonie-guru-lora · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Loonie Guru v1 (LoRA adapter) Loonie Guru is the model inside Guru, the assistant of the Loonie personal-finance app. It runs on the person's own computer (llama.cpp), so their information never leaves it.

sources.title: loonie.ai - All your wealth in one place, with a Guru to help it grow
sources.snippet: Loonie is a free Windows app that keeps all your accounts, in any currency, in one place and gives you a Financial Guru to consult on your own numbers. Works offline, with or without AI. Private on your computer.
